client.business_model: Multi-state women’s health provider operating OB-GYN clinics, maternal-fetal medicine, and telehealth services
client.sponsor_pe_firm: BlueMountain Capital Management (major minority investor); Deerfield Management also invested
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 by Sean Glass and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Advantia Health has grown through acquisitions such as the 2019 purchase of Heartland Women’s Healthcare (25 locations) and has attracted $45 million in growth capital from BlueMountain Capital in 2020 to expand its integrated women’s health platform.

revenue.source: Zippia ($13.0 M, 2024-01-05); Growjo ($22.4 M, 2024); Buzzfile ($29.1 M, 2024); CanvasBusinessModel.com ($89 M, 2024)
revenue.notes: No official filings or press releases provide revenue. Third-party estimates range widely from $13 M to $89 M; therefore amount is set to null due to high uncertainty.

locations.source: Advantia Health website locations page (accessed 2026-01-26) which lists 24 distinct clinic addresses across IL, MO, MD, VA, and DC
locations.notes: Press release (PR Newswire, 2019-02-20) states acquisition of Heartland added 25 sites, implying total could exceed 40, but only 24 active locations are currently shown on the official locations page.

employees.source: Zippia company profile (750 employees, 2025); LinkedIn company page (501-1,000 employees, accessed 2026-01-26)
employees.notes: Zippia’s figure of 750 falls within LinkedIn’s reported range and is used as a midpoint estimate.

extraction_notes: Official company name confirmed in signed services agreement (page 1) and Treya presentations.

BlueMountain Capital’s $45 M growth investment (2020) and Deerfield Management’s earlier funding (2016) identified in company press releases; degree of ownership not publicly specified but BlueMountain is the largest disclosed institutional investor.
Revenue estimates vary widely across third-party sites with no corroborating primary source; revenue therefore reported as null with low confidence.
Location count taken from the current official website; earlier PRs suggest a higher historical count, indicating possible consolidation or rebranding of sites.
Employee count uses Zippia figure which aligns with LinkedIn’s range; other sources (Buzzfile 259, LeadIQ 501) differ, hence medium confidence.
